lenses.name: Population
lenses.description: Residents per km² of department land.

lenses.name: GDP per capita
lenses.description: Department GDP divided by residents. This is output per resident, not household earnings.

lenses.name: Employment density
lenses.description: Employment by workplace per km² of department land.

lenses.name: Industry
lenses.description: Industry and construction employment as a share of all employment.

lenses.name: Forest
lenses.description: Share of each hex classified as tree cover by CORINE Land Cover. Null in overseas insets because the metropolitan CORINE extract does not cover them. Null in overseas insets because the metropolitan CORINE extract does not cover them. Null in overseas insets because the metropolitan CORINE extract does not cover them.

lenses.name: Farmland
lenses.description: Share of each hex classified as cropland by CORINE Land Cover. Null in overseas insets because the metropolitan CORINE extract does not cover them. Null in overseas insets because the metropolitan CORINE extract does not cover them. Null in overseas insets because the metropolitan CORINE extract does not cover them.

lenses.name: Built-up
lenses.description: Share of each hex classified as built-up by CORINE Land Cover. Null in overseas insets because the metropolitan CORINE extract does not cover them. Null in overseas insets because the metropolitan CORINE extract does not cover them. Null in overseas insets because the metropolitan CORINE extract does not cover them.

lenses.name: Median standard of living
lenses.description: Median standard of living by department (INSEE comparateur de territoires 2023).

lenses.name: Poverty
lenses.description: Share of residents below 60% of median standard of living.

lenses.name: Unemployment
lenses.description: Unemployed census residents aged 15–64 ÷ the active population aged 15–64.

lenses.name: Higher education
lenses.description: Residents aged 15 or older who are no longer in initial education and whose highest diploma is in higher education, census 2023.

lenses.name: Residents 65+
lenses.description: Residents aged 65 or older as a share of all residents, census 2023.

lenses.name: Immigration
lenses.description: Immigrants as a share of all residents, census 2023. INSEE defines an immigrant as a person born abroad who was not born a French national.

lenses.name: Public transport commuting
lenses.description: Employed residents aged 15 or older whose main home-to-work mode is public transport, census 2023.

lenses.name: Car commuting
lenses.description: Employed residents aged 15 or older whose main home-to-work mode is a car, van or truck, census 2023.

lenses.name: Population growth
lenses.description: Population change 2017–2023.

lenses.name: Homeownership
lenses.description: Owner-occupied share of main residences.

lenses.name: Second homes
lenses.description: Second homes and occasional dwellings as a share of all dwellings.

lenses.name: Vacant homes
lenses.description: Vacant dwellings as a share of all dwellings.

lenses.name: Le Pen vote 2022
lenses.description: Marine Le Pen's share of valid second-round votes in the 2022 presidential election, aggregated from commune results to departments.

lenses.name: Macron vote 2022
lenses.description: Emmanuel Macron's share of valid second-round votes in the 2022 presidential election, aggregated from commune results to departments.

lenses.name: Abstention 2022
lenses.description: Abstentions as a share of registered voters in the 2022 presidential second round.

lenses.name: Natural disasters
lenses.description: Catastrophe-naturelle recognitions in 2000–2025, normalized by today's commune count. Retired-commune recognitions remain attributed to their department; this is administrative recognition frequency, not measured damage.

lenses.name: Flood events
lenses.description: Flood, mudflow, wave and groundwater-rise recognitions as a share of local catastrophe-naturelle recognitions since 2000.

lenses.name: Drought events
lenses.description: Drought recognitions as a share of local catastrophe-naturelle recognitions since 2000.
